project_context.title: Stock Data Viewer (Polygon.io - Delayed)
project_context.description: PyQt5 desktop app for delayed US stock data with Supabase-backed authentication and paper trading. Users log in, load tickers (WebSocket trades + REST snapshot for today stats), view Info/Chart tabs, monitor a Time & Sales tape, and place paper market orders on the Trade tab. Chart uses pyqtgraph (1Y daily view, zoom/timeframes, RSI) and a live WebSocket updates prices.

database_integration.usage: Authentication (email/password), profiles, accounts, orders, fills, positions, ledger, snapshots caching
database_integration.tables_auto_created: profiles, accounts, orders, fills, positions, ledger, portfolio_snapshots

live.ws_status: CONNECTING, CONNECTED, DELAYED, RECONNECTING, ERROR, DISCONNECTED

static_daily.pe_ratio: Displayed if available; may be blank
static_daily.market_status: Heuristic via ET time: PRE-MARKET, MARKET HOURS, AFTER-HOURS, CLOSED

trading.positions: Tracked via fills and stored in Supabase
trading.portfolio: Equity, cash, market value, realized/unrealized P&L

tabs.tab: Live data, today stats, key metrics, company description (fixed-height QTextEdit), Time & Sales tape
Candlestick chart with timeframe buttons (1D/1W/1M/3M/YTD/1Y/5Y), RSI pane toggle, Volume toggle, Log Y toggle, crosshair readout.
Portfolio header, order entry ticket, open positions table, order blotter synced with Supabase

candles.x_axis: Dynamic labels (months/days/hours:minutes based on zoom level; debounced range handling)

file.purpose: Configuration and timing constants (Polygon + Supabase + trading)
REST methods and WebSocket stream with status callbacks
Data classes (CompanyDetails, DailyStats, RollingStats, Candle, Account/Order/Fill/Position)
MainWindow UI, Info/Chart/Trade tabs, WsThread, timers

websocket.thread: QThread (WsThread) with its own asyncio loop

threading.rest_loading: threading.Thread for initial loads and snapshot polling work
threading.chart_loading: threading.Thread computes arrays for candles/timeframes, emits chart_candles_ready
threading.ui_updates: All GUI updates via Qt signals/slots
threading.trade_execution: Broker executes orders synchronously on GUI thread (signals emitted to Trade tab)

switch_ticker.sequence: Stop old WS (requestInterruption → stop → quit → wait up to 1800–4800ms → deleteLater; last-resort terminate) then start new after grace. Snapshot + chart timers restarted from GUI thread via queued slots.

lifecycle.ws_status_flow: CONNECTING → CONNECTED → DELAYED on first trade; on errors: ERROR then RECONNECTING; DISCONNECTED on stop
lifecycle.timer_starts: All Qt timers started on GUI thread (queued slots) to avoid QThread timer warnings.

signals_mainwindow.chart_candles_ready: numpy array for candles, datetime list, level id

steps.step: Stop old WebSocket and snapshot timer
Compute 30d avg volume and 52w high/low via /v2/aggs range

chart_loading.when: On first open of Chart tab per ticker; and on timeframe or level changes
chart_loading.range_days: ~365 for daily; intraday uses 5m/30m/1m based on timeframe and level

timeframe_buttons.view_lock: When a timeframe is selected, panning/zooming is constrained to the dataset window; zoom levels do not auto-switch.

zoom_levels.axis: Dynamic X-axis tick formatter per level/span

trading_flow.auth: Login dialog on startup (Supabase email/password, cached session optional)
trading_flow.account: On first login, create "Paper-1" account with starting capital; reuse existing account thereafter
trading_flow.order_entry: Trade tab submits market BUY/SELL orders synchronously, validates cash/position, inserts order/fill/ledger/position updates via Supabase
trading_flow.signals: Broker emits orderAccepted, orderFilled, positionsUpdated, portfolioUpdated, omsError; Trade tab updates blotter/positions/portfolio header
trading_flow.tape: Info tab Time & Sales widget backfills via Polygon /v3/trades, paginated; appends live trades from WebSocket

usage.load_ticker: Enter ticker (e.g., AAPL) and click Load
usage.status: Feed status shows lifecycle; DELAYED appears after first event
usage.chart: Open Chart tab to render 1-year candlesticks

known_limitations.quotes: No Q.* WebSocket quotes; bid/ask via snapshot polling
known_limitations.pe_ratio: May be unavailable in reference data
known_limitations.intraday: Intraday data is delayed and may fall back to daily aggregates if entitlement/rate-limits block minute queries.

success_criteria.chart: Timeframe windows obey view-lock; intraday/daily candlesticks render correctly and refresh
success_criteria.status_display: Accurate connection status and ET timestamps
